title: Review repair C: CI test timeout, runstate doc claim, gate-output redaction, restart-evidence test
description: Should-fix findings from the final review that touch CI, internal/runstate and one gate detail: (1) .github/workflows/ci.yml:46,51 and the epic acceptance run bare 'go test ./...'; internal/reconcile now needs 600-620s so go's default 10m package timeout kills it ('panic: test timed out after 10m0s' observed by two reviewers) — pin -timeout (e.g. 45m) in both CI steps and in [testing.commands].go in .tick/runners.toml is NOT yours (orchestrator-owned): add a Makefile or scripts/test.sh target the docs point at and set the timeout in ci.yml; also look for cheap wins that shorten the reconcile suite under -short (fewer real dispatches per test, shared built binary) without weakening any assertion. (2) internal/runstate/doc.go:23 says the only local ref the store moves is the integration branch via CommitLocal, but ensureRunTag (store.go:663) runs 'git tag -f ticfac/run-<id>' in the target repository, force-moving a local tag — fix the claim and make the tag creation refuse to clobber a pre-existing local tag that points elsewhere. (3) internal/reconcile/gate.go:181 commits gate stdout/stderr verbatim (Redacted:false) to the integration branch on origin; the gate runs in an os.MkdirTemp worktree so failing output can carry the operator's host temp path into a public repo (the class 0x1 fixed): redact the temp worktree path, the repo path and the home dir from captured output before it is recorded (set Redacted accordingly) and extend no_host_path_test to a failing gate. (4) internal/reconcile/restart_test.go:121 TestARestartReusesTheGateEvidenceItAlreadyPaidFor passes with the guard removed (EvidenceKeys can never count a key twice); make it real with a gate command that appends to a counter file. (5) internal/reconcile/guards.go:16 comment and lifecycle claim about StrikeOut having a production caller — leave the wiring to repair D; just do not touch guards.go here. Scope: .github/, scripts/ or Makefile, internal/runstate, and ONLY gate.go's output-capture lines plus restart_test.go in internal/reconcile (repair A owns the rest of that package; coordinate by keeping your reconcile edits to those two spots).
acceptance_criteria: CI runs the suites with an explicit timeout and is green; runstate doc matches the code and a pre-existing foreign local tag is not clobbered; gate output on origin carries no host path (test); the restart-evidence test fails when the create-if-absent guard is removed; go test -short -timeout 45m ./... green
